capabilities: Import source URLs from .txt and .url files
Move .mp3, .mp4, and image assets into a songs folder
Extract supported files from .zip archives before importing
Create and update Markdown song notes with metadata fields
Watch the source folder on an interval for new files
extras: Desktop-only because zip extraction uses Node.js APIs; distributed as a zip for manual installation into .obsidian/plugins, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to batch-import source links and media files from a drop folder into structured notes with grouped assets.
summary: Desktop-only plugin that imports music source URLs and media assets from a source_docs folder into organized song notes.
